snippet.title: Territory Gameplay Trailer v3
snippet.description:
Alpha 7 is live and playable on the steam. Play locally on your own PC or on any of the 5 on demand persistent server regions. Sydney, Singapore, Ohio, Frankfurt, Sao Paulo. PVP and PVE Servers available in all regions.

Official Website
https://territorysurvival.com
Steam Store Page
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2062940/Territory/

https://discord.gg/up6tns6Jzc
